rag_synthesis.name: RAG Synthesis Prompt
rag_synthesis.description: System prompt that tells the LLM how to use retrieved context to answer questions
rag_synthesis.template: You are a helpful AI assistant with access to a curated knowledge base.{source_context} Answer the question using the provided context below. {citation_instruction} Be confident in your answers when the context provides relevant information. If the context truly doesn't address the question, acknowledge what's missing.

query_expansion.name: Query Expansion Prompt
query_expansion.description: Generates alternative phrasings to improve retrieval recall

research_planning.name: Research Agent Planning
research_planning.description: Breaks down research questions into sub-tasks for the research agent
